collections.title: 100 Life-Changing Movies
collections.subtitle: Stories that transform how you see the world
collections.description: A curated collection of films that have profoundly shaped human consciousness and understanding.
collections.philosophy: Cinema as a mirror for personal growth and societal change
collections.curatorNote: These films aren't just entertainment—they're experiences that reshape your perspective on life, love, and purpose.

collections.title: Best Philosophical Anime
collections.subtitle: Animation that explores deep questions
collections.description: Anime series and films that tackle philosophy, ethics, and the human condition through the medium of animation.
collections.philosophy: Animation as a medium for exploring complex philosophical concepts
collections.curatorNote: These shows prove that animation can be the most profound medium for exploring life's biggest questions.

entries.title: Interstellar
entries.description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
entries.whyWatch: Explores the power of love transcending time and space, with stunning visuals and scientific accuracy.
lifeLessons: Human connection is our greatest strength
reflectionPrompts: What would you sacrifice for humanity?
How does love connect us across distances?
entries.culturalImpact: Revitalized interest in space exploration and theoretical physics

entries.title: Vinland Saga
entries.description: A young Viking prince seeks revenge for his father's death, but grows to question the cycle of violence.
entries.whyWatch: A profound exploration of violence, peace, and what it means to be truly strong.
reflectionPrompts: What does true strength mean to you?
Can peace be achieved through violence?
What would you sacrifice for peace?
entries.culturalImpact: Modern masterpiece exploring pacifist philosophy through action storytelling

entries.title: The Matrix
entries.description: A computer hacker learns about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.
entries.whyWatch: Revolutionary filmmaking that questions the nature of reality and human choice.
reflectionPrompts: How much control do you have over your life?
Would you choose truth over comfort?
entries.culturalImpact: Changed action cinema and philosophical discussions about reality

quotes: Love is the one thing that transcends dimensions of time and space
reflectionExercises: Write about someone you love across distance
journalingPrompts: How has love changed your perception of time?
What would you risk for those you love?
